fullContentHtml:
Indian Overseas Bank IOB Apprentice Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Indian Overseas Bank (IOB) has released the result for the recruitment of Apprentice posts on the official website. This recruitment was released for 750 posts. Applications for the Indian Overseas Bank IOB Apprentice Recruitment 206 were accepted from 06 July 2026 to 27 July 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their Indian Overseas Bank IOB Apprentice 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 06 July 2026
  • Application Start Date : 07 July 2026
  • Last Date : 27 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 28 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 02 August 2026
  • Result : 15 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS (Male) : Rs. 944/-
  • General, OBC, EWS (Female) : Rs. 708/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 236/-
  • Fee Include 18% GST
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Indian Overseas Bank IOB Apprentice Result 2026?

Indian Overseas Bank IOB Apprentice Result 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 27 July 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://All India Exam Result.cm/

How to download result?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
